items.title: Health Monitor & UI: Added System Health Monitor dock with real-time graphs (FPS, Total Current, Servo Load); implemented sensorless servo polling (Reg 0x3C) for load data on Debug Board; added Pin Assignment Help window; consolidated Dock panels into 'Widgets' menu.
Camera Fix: Added stabilization delays (1.0s init, 0.5s switch) to open_camera to prevent resolution locking to 640x480 on slow webcams.
Settings: camera_index set to 1 after test suite showed index 2/3/4 unavailable; improves camera open reliability.
Video display: use stride-safe QImage bytes_per_line and contentsRect sizing to avoid partial-frame rendering; Tracking: min-step now scales with tracking speed for more responsive autotrack.
Tracking: start_tracking now clears manual_override to prevent hidden suppression from blocking autotracking movement.
Tracking: enforce 1° minimum step outside deadzone to overcome bus-servo deadband and ensure visible movement.
Tracking tuning: lowered deadzone, reduced smoothing, increased movement sensitivity, and disabled precision mode to make autotracking movement more visible.

Stabilization: disabled idle/sentry hooks, auto-fire, and recording; removed custom tooltip event filters; replaced state auto-corrections with logging; added explicit pan/tilt clamp guard and reduced silent exception swallowing.
App: Debug Board Direct mode now probes bus-servo checksum (sub vs xor) on primary serial so commands match the debug board protocol.
App: Debug Board Direct mode now connects using debug-board COM/baud (not Nano port), ensuring UI pan/tilt drives the bus servos.
Firmware: lowered Nano bus UART baud to 57600 to improve SoftwareSerial reliability for debug-board comms.
Firmware: added BUS_HALF_DUPLEX option and a guarded single-wire bus write helper for SoftwareSerial to support shared RX/TX debug-board data lines; initializes bus pin to input in half-duplex mode.

Camera/BusServos: open_camera now prefers delivered frame shape over CAP_PROP to prevent partial-frame rendering; debug-board connect probes checksum mode (subtract vs XOR) and bus writes use auto dual-send fallback when checksum is unknown; Dual Port now falls back to full P/T over Nano when bus probe is unconfirmed, and sends PTEN0 only after a successful bus probe; tools/run_all_tests.py improved to report port-open errors clearly and tries both checksum variants.

App/Firmware: Added selectable serial modes: Nano ASCII (one-port), Debug Board Direct (one-port bus-servo packets), and Dual Port (Nano for IO + Debug Board for PAN/TILT). Firmware adds PTEN 0/1 to disable Nano pan/tilt output and supports IO-only command lines (P/T optional)

Current monitoring: made current sensors optional (no pan/tilt sensors required); added Total Current Sensor toggle in UI + settings; current protection now effectively disables when no sensors are enabled; firmware supports total-only telemetry via legacy 'STAT I=' format

Arduino: Implemented Yahboom serial-bus packet protocol (FF FF framing, 115200 baud, 0..4095 ticks) in DB3000_SerialBus_Upgrade_2026.ino with checksum behavior matching vendor debug tool (write pos @0x2A, read pos @0x38)

Cleanup: Addressed silent exceptions in UI building and YOLO audio with logging; fixed state log dump to stable repo path; added atomic _sync_tracking_flags helper; moved YOLO loading to background thread; archived old .md files to docs/archive/

Servo upgrade prep: Current Monitor dock (Pan/Tilt/Total mA) + hardened telemetry parsing (CUR + legacy STAT I=...) and ensured serial input draining even when redundant-command skips or TX pause occur
Servo: fix manual D-pad up/down axis wiring (use tilt helpers) + fix Sentry tab switching so tracking/aiming state stays consistent (prevents 'autotracking no movement' from silent pause)
Tools: added non-blocking Pan/Tilt Range Check (Tools menu) with safe pause/restore and best-effort tilt movement confirmation
Fix: prevent pan/tilt direction desync (sync internal flip_* flags to invert_* UI/settings; persist invert_tilt changes)
Detection UI: Basic/Advanced toggle + mode-relevant visibility (AgentChangeID: DETECTION_UI_BASIC_ADVANCED_v1)
